read.bigIdea: Michigan is a big beer state.
read.where: The Brewers Association counts **410 craft breweries** in Michigan for **2025**, **8th** in the US, with about **$1.66 billion** in economic impact. The **Michigan Brewers Guild** calls it “**The Great Beer State**” and ranked it **6th** in 2022, counting all breweries and brewpubs. The numbers differ because of what they count, so say “**top ten**” unless you name the source and year. Bell’s and Founders are now owned by larger companies, so they don’t count as craft.
read.mixup: Rankings depend on what’s counted: all breweries, or craft only.
read.sayIt: Michigan is one of the top ten beer states in the country.

video.title: Michigan Brewers Guild Director Talks Rise of Michigan Beer! |Megacast Interview, September 26, 2022

read.where: The **Michigan Brewers Guild** began with a meeting in a **Saginaw** pub on October 22, **1997** (49 people from 30 breweries). It had nearly **300** member breweries in 2022, promotes **July** as **Michigan Beer Month**, and has run a **Summer Beer Festival** since **1998**, plus winter and fall festivals around the state.

video.title: Larry Bell's 35th Anniversary of Bell's Brewery Speech

read.where: Larry **Bell** opened a homebrew shop in **Kalamazoo** in 1983, and the brewery sold its first beer in **1985**, brewed in a soup pot. Its **Eccentric Café** (1993) was the first on-site pub at a Michigan brewery, after Bell helped change the law. **Oberon** was first brewed in **1992**, **Two Hearted Ale** in **1997**. In **2021** Bell’s was sold to Lion Little World Beverages (Kirin’s craft arm), under New Belgium.
read.mixup: Bell’s is still brewed in Michigan, but by the BA’s definition it isn’t craft anymore.

video.title: The Rise and Fall of Stroh's, Detroit's First Fire-Brewed Beer | Clip

read.where: **Founders** opened in downtown **Grand Rapids** (since **1997**). It nearly went bankrupt, then turned around brewing bigger beers: **Dirty Bastard**, **KBS**, bourbon-barrel aging, and later **All Day IPA**. In 2023 it merged into **Mahou USA**. Detroit’s **Stroh’s** began in **1850**, known for “**fire-brewed**” beer (kettles over direct flame), but after borrowing heavily to buy other breweries it collapsed in **2000**.

sources: Brewers Association, State Craft Beer Stats (2025); Michigan Brewers Guild (mibeer.com); Bell’s Brewery, History (bellsbeer.com); Good Beer Hunting, Sightlines (Nov 10, 2021); Founders Brewing Co., About (foundersbrewing.com); Oxford Companion to Beer (via beerandbrewing.com). Checked Nov 8, 2026.
